title: Surrounded
description: A coastal brown bear surrounds a school of sockeye salmon (Oncorhynchus nerka) in the Alaska Peninsula. Each year, these fish journey thousands of miles from the Pacific Ocean to the freshwaters of Alaska. They are constantly leaping above water during the journey, where the bears wait to catch them. Photographer Mike Rigney told National Geographic it was "easily one of the most beautiful natural displays I've ever seen."
translated_description: 一只沿海棕熊在阿拉斯加半岛围住一群红鲑（学名：Oncorhynchus nerka）。每年，这些鱼从太平洋跋涉数千英里来到阿拉斯加的淡水水域。在旅途中，它们不断跃出水面，而棕熊就在那里等着捕捉它们。摄影师迈克·里格尼告诉《国家地理》，这“无疑是我见过的最美的自然景观之一。”
